leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement secure JWT storage in React using localStorage
Construct a function to decode JWT tokens and extract payload data
Apply conditional rendering based on authentication state from JWT
Initialize authentication state by retrieving stored JWT on component mount
Integrate JWT decoding with protected route components
Manipulate JWT data to display user information in the UI
Configure token validation by checking expiration timestamps
Control authentication flow by clearing JWT tokens on logout
